verdicts.rationale: Contract explicitly documents '400 on dimension mismatch or invalid params' but source code implements HTTP 200 for all responses. While source code shows this is by-design for REST v2 API pattern, it contradicts published API documentation. This creates confusion for API consumers who expect standard HTTP status codes. Developer cognition confirms REST v2 has known issues with data type validation and cross-channel inconsistencies. The defect is the mismatch between documented contract (HTTP 400) and implementation (HTTP 200 + error code), not the error handling itself which works correctly.
